supporting_observations.claim: The account svc-render experienced failed logon attempts starting at 13:31 UTC on 2026-10-27.
The failed logons occurred on FILE-NWD-01.

The failures correlate with the scheduled password rotation for svc-render at 13:30 UTC, as the RenderQueue job on FILE-NWD-01 re-authenticates every minute and requires a manual update following rotation.
